svg.title: Rank-based BPE is not longest-prefix matching
svg.desc: An authored example with byte ranks and three merges: bc at rank 256, ab at 257, and bcd at 258. Encoding abcd gives a plus bcd, not ab plus c plus d.

g.text: Rank-based BPE is not longest-prefix matching
Toy vocabulary: all 256 bytes, bc = 256, ab = 257, bcd = 258; abcd is absent.
Input is one regex piece: abcd. Smaller rank means earlier merge priority.
Merge bc first: 256 is smaller than 257.
Choose ab as the longest token at the start.
Then merge bc + d using rank 258.
Both outputs preserve the bytes, but only the left follows these BPE merge priorities.
Authored illustration of the pinned implementation; not an official encoding or benchmark.
